description:
New Ariel 80 Orange - Built to party

If you live for laps, destroy rear tyres and always send it sideways, you're going to want the Ariel 80.
Fun first and 27.5 for life, our take on a park bike is designed to thrive at every UK centre and even the Alps.
This thing loves to pop off lips, swing sideward and flick through trees. The bigger the grin on your face, the harder the Ariel 80 is going to work to keep it there.
Our all-new, custom-butted and hydroformed 6066 aluminium frame has been put to the test by bottom-out king Matt Walker and survived to make it into production.
Every millimetre of the 180mm of travel is designed to work hard, whether that's taking out rock chatter and braking bumps, sending the jump line, or holding on for traction in loose turns.
Our 80 model is a great chance to get all the bike, with enough cash left over to head someplace with real mountains and push this beast to the limit.
You'll never feel short-changed on travel when charging through boulders thanks to the RockShox Zeb up front, while out back the Marzocchi Bomber CR coil deals with the aftermath.
Shimano's new Deore drivetrain gives wide-range 11–51 gearing, with an upgraded SLX rear mech. Stopping duties are handled by the ever-capable four-pot Deore brakes, matched to 203mm rotors for added bite.
The DT Swiss E532 rims are enduro-ready, with a 30mm internal width providing plenty for the 2.4 Maxxis Minion DHRII tyres to fill out onto. Both are tubeless-ready.
A RaceFace 35mm finishing kit and dropper post from KS complete a spec sheet that has no weakness — and that's without mentioning the small details.
There's internal routing for everything — including a dropper post, superboost spacing for additional clearance, and big bearings which last longer and are commonly available should you need to refresh them.
Just don't try and stick a 29er fork up front. You’ll set off our inbuilt safety device that’ll alert everyone on PinkBike to the crimes you’re committing.
Please note — the Saracen Ariel does not come supplied with pedals. Add some from our gear store!
